history.summary: Marta meets Lukas, who takes her to the station free of charge. She promises to tell him about her journey tomorrow.
history.cliffhanger: At the station, Marta is about to discover that her ticket is missing.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Guten Morgen! Fahren Sie zum Bahnhof?
scenes.fa: صبح بخیر! به ایستگاه قطار می‌روید؟
scenes.scene: Marta stands beside the taxi and politely asks Lukas a question; medium two shot.
scenes.motion: Marta speaks and raises one hand politely; Lukas listens and nods.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Ja, natürlich. Steigen Sie bitte ein.
scenes.fa: بله، البته. لطفاً سوار شوید.
scenes.scene: Lukas stands by the open passenger door and welcomes Marta; the seat is visible.
scenes.motion: Lukas speaks and opens the passenger door wider, offering his hand.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Was kostet die Fahrt?
scenes.fa: کرایهٔ مسیر چقدر است؟
scenes.scene: Medium close-up of Marta beside the taxi, holding her small coin purse.
scenes.motion: Marta speaks, opens her purse and looks up with a questioning expression.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Normalerweise kostet sie zehn Euro.
scenes.fa: معمولاً ده یورو می‌شود.
scenes.scene: Medium close-up of Lukas outside the teal taxi, facing Marta just off camera.
scenes.motion: Lukas speaks kindly and makes one small explanatory gesture with his open hand.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Oh, ich habe nur fünf Euro dabei.
scenes.fa: اوه، من فقط پنج یورو همراهم دارم.
scenes.scene: Marta looks worried into her nearly empty purse beside the open taxi door.
scenes.motion: Marta speaks, looks down at the coins and then looks back up at Lukas.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Kein Problem. Heute fahren Sie kostenlos.
scenes.fa: اشکالی ندارد. امروز رایگان می‌روید.
scenes.scene: Both characters beside the open teal taxi, Lukas gently holding out his hand to help Marta.
scenes.motion: Lukas speaks with a warm smile, takes Marta's hand gently and nods reassuringly.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Wirklich? Das ist sehr freundlich von Ihnen.
scenes.fa: واقعاً؟ این خیلی مهربانانه است.
scenes.scene: Medium close-up of Marta, her worried expression turning into a relieved smile.
scenes.motion: Marta speaks in delighted surprise, smiles and briefly lifts her free hand to her chest.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Ich helfe Ihnen mit der Tasche.
scenes.fa: در برداشتن کیف کمکتان می‌کنم.
scenes.scene: Lukas carefully takes Marta's leather handbag while she stands by the open passenger door.
scenes.motion: Lukas speaks, gently lifts the handbag and moves it towards the back seat.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Vielen Dank. Mein Zug fährt um zwölf Uhr.
scenes.fa: خیلی ممنون. قطار من ساعت دوازده حرکت می‌کند.
scenes.scene: Marta is seated comfortably in the rear of the taxi, looking towards Lukas at the driver's door.
scenes.motion: Marta speaks, settles into the seat and looks towards the driver with a grateful smile.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Keine Sorge. Wir kommen rechtzeitig an.
scenes.fa: نگران نباشید. به‌موقع می‌رسیم.
scenes.scene: Interior taxi two shot with Lukas in the driver seat and Marta in the rear seat, village street outside.
scenes.motion: Lukas speaks reassuringly, looks ahead and gently turns the steering wheel as the street moves outside.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Da vorne ist schon der Bahnhof.
scenes.fa: ایستگاه قطار همین جلو است.
scenes.scene: Taxi interior looking past Lukas towards the grand train station ahead; Marta visible in the back seat.
scenes.motion: Lukas speaks and briefly points towards the station ahead, while the taxi slows smoothly.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Danke! Wie kann ich mich bedanken?
scenes.fa: ممنون! چطور می‌توانم از شما تشکر کنم؟
scenes.scene: At the station curb, Marta looks out through the open rear window towards Lukas standing outside.
scenes.motion: Marta speaks gratefully through the open window and makes a small warm gesture.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Erzählen Sie mir morgen von Ihrer Reise.
scenes.fa: فردا از سفرتان برایم تعریف کنید.
scenes.scene: Lukas beside the taxi and Marta at the open window, both waving goodbye at the station.
scenes.motion: Lukas speaks with a friendly smile, waves gently; Marta returns the wave.

plan.summary: Lukas realizes Marta left her train ticket on the taxi backseat. He rushes into the busy station just in time to hand it to her before her train departs, but a new oversight soon appears.
plan.cliffhanger: Back in his taxi after the train departs, Lukas discovers Marta's heavy bunch of house keys lying under the passenger seat.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Wo ist denn meine Fahrkarte für den Zug?
scenes.fa: بلیت قطار من کجاست؟
scenes.scene: Medium shot of elderly Marta standing in the grand station entrance hall under a large timetable board, rummaging through her open leather handbag with a worried expression.
scenes.motion: Marta frantically sifts through the contents of her bag and speaks to herself with furrowed brows.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Marta hat ihr Zugticket im Auto vergessen!
scenes.fa: مارتا بلیت قطارش را در ماشین جا گذاشته است!
scenes.scene: Interior shot of Lukas in his taxi outside the station, glancing into the rearview mirror and spotting a white paper train ticket on the backseat.
scenes.motion: Lukas turns around in the driver seat, reaches back to pick up the ticket, and gasps in surprise.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Ich muss mich beeilen, der Zug fährt bald.
scenes.fa: باید عجله کنم، قطار به‌زودی حرکت می‌کند.
scenes.scene: Cinematic low-angle shot outside the railway station entrance as Lukas quickly steps out of his beige taxi with the ticket firmly in hand.
scenes.motion: Lukas pushes the taxi door shut with his hip and sets off into a brisk jog toward the station doors.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Der Zug nach Hamburg kommt in fünf Minuten.
scenes.fa: قطار به مقصد هامبورگ تا پنج دقیقه دیگر می‌آید.
scenes.scene: Wide eye-level shot on train platform four, showing morning travelers walking past Marta who stares anxiously up at the digital platform display.
scenes.motion: Marta looks up at the glowing platform sign, clenches her hands together, and speaks nervously.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Hallo Lukas, ich suche überall mein Ticket!
scenes.fa: سلام لوکاس، من همه‌جا دنبال بلیتم می‌گردم!
scenes.scene: Close-up of Marta holding an old flip phone to her ear on the noisy platform, her face tense with worry.
scenes.motion: Marta answers her ringing phone, talking urgently while watching the empty railway tracks.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Keine Sorge, Marta, ich habe Ihre Fahrkarte.
scenes.fa: نگران نباشید، مارتا، بلیت شما پیش من است.
scenes.scene: Tracking medium shot of Lukas holding his smartphone to his ear while weaving through busy travelers in the bustling main station concourse.
scenes.motion: Lukas jogs through the crowd, speaking reassuringly into his phone as he holds the ticket in front of him.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Ich stehe oben auf Gleis vier, mein Junge.
scenes.fa: من بالا در سکوی چهار ایستاده‌ام، پسرم.
scenes.scene: Medium shot of Marta on platform four near the top of the wide stone stairs, clutching her wool coat tightly against the draft.
scenes.motion: Marta speaks into her phone with relief and turns her gaze expectantly toward the stairs.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Ich sehe Sie schon bei der großen Uhr!
scenes.fa: شما را کنار ساعت بزرگ می‌بینم!
scenes.scene: Dynamic shot from bottom of the platform stairs looking up, showing Lukas bounding up two steps at a time toward the bright platform level.
scenes.motion: Lukas reaches the top landing, lowers his phone, waves the ticket above his head, and speaks out loud.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Hier ist Ihr Ticket, pünktlich zur Abfahrt.
scenes.fa: این هم بلیت شما، درست به‌موقع قبل از حرکت.
scenes.scene: Two-shot of Lukas and Marta under the platform clock as Lukas catches his breath and extends the ticket toward her with a warm smile.
scenes.motion: Lukas hands the folded ticket into Marta's waiting palms while catching his breath.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Du bist heute wirklich mein rettender Engel, Lukas.
scenes.fa: تو امروز واقعاً فرشته نجات من هستی، لوکاس.
scenes.scene: Warm close-up of Marta beaming gratefully at Lukas, her weathered face glowing with affectionate relief.
scenes.motion: Marta takes the ticket with both hands, gently touches Lukas's forearm, and speaks with heartfelt gratitude.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Jetzt steige ich ein und winke dir.
scenes.fa: حالا سوار می‌شوم و برایت دست تکان می‌دهم.
scenes.scene: Wide cinematic shot of the sleek red train gliding into the platform with a soft hiss of air brakes as morning sunlight streams through the station glass roof.
scenes.motion: Marta lifts her small travel bag, turns toward the opening train doors, and speaks over her shoulder with a cheerful nod.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Das war knapp, aber alles ist gut gegangen.
scenes.fa: نزدیک بود دیر شود، اما همه‌چیز خوب پیش رفت.
scenes.scene: Exterior street shot outside the station as Lukas returns to his taxi, opening the driver's door with a contented sigh.
scenes.motion: Lukas smiles to himself, slides into the driver seat, and closes the car door behind him.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Moment mal, das sind doch Martas Hausschlüssel!
scenes.fa: یک لحظه صبر کن، این‌ها که کلیدهای خانه مارتا هستند!
scenes.scene: Close-up interior shot focusing on the dark passenger floor mat where an antique brass key ring with multiple keys and a floral tag lies half-hidden.
scenes.motion: Lukas freezes as he leans forward, stares wide-eyed at the floor mat, and points in stunned realization.
